title: On the well-posedness of the initial value problem for the MMT model
summary: This work investigates the initial value problem (IVP) for the two-parameter family of dispersive wave equations known as the Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak (MMT) model, which arises in the weak turbulence theory of random waves. The MMT model can be viewed as a derivative nonlinear Schrödinger (dNLS) equation where both the nonlinearity and dispersion involve nonlocal fractional derivatives.
